title: Sheafification of a presheaf of commutative rings on a space: existence and underlying abelian sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $\mathcal P$ a presheaf of commutative rings on $X$. Then (1) $\mathcal P$ has a sheafification $\theta:\mathcal P\to\mathcal P^\#$ in sheaves of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]: $\mathcal P^\#$ is a sheaf of commutative rings on $X$, $\theta$ is a morphism of presheaves of commutative rings, and every morphism of presheaves of commutative rings from $\mathcal P$ to a sheaf of commutative rings $\mathcal B$ factors as $u\circ\theta$ for exactly one morphism of sheaves of commutative rings $u:\mathcal P^\#\to\mathcal B$; (2) the underlying presheaf of abelian groups of $\mathcal P^\#$ is a sheaf of abelian groups, and with the map $\theta$ (regarded as a morphism of presheaves of abelian groups) it is a sheafification of the underlying presheaf of abelian groups of $\mathcal P$: every morphism of presheaves of abelian groups from $\mathcal P$ to a sheaf of abelian groups factors uniquely through $\theta$ by a morphism of sheaves of abelian groups. (Likewise the underlying sheaf of sets of $\mathcal P^\#$, with $\theta$, is the sheafification of the underlying presheaf of sets of $\mathcal P$.)

source.place: Sheaves, Lemma 0087 (lemma-sheafify-presheaf-structures: for a type of algebraic structure $(\mathcal C,F)$, (1) the underlying sheaf of sets of $\mathcal F^\#$ is the sheafification of the underlying presheaf of sets, (2) the universal property among sheaves with values in $\mathcal C$), applied to commutative rings and to abelian groups, which are types of algebraic structure by Lemma 007N (lemma-list-algebraic-structures); clause (2) follows by applying 0087 to the underlying abelian presheaf and comparing the two sheafifications on underlying sheaves of sets (both are the sheafification of the same presheaf of sets); for sites: Sites, Section 00YR (section-sheaves-algebraic-structures), property ($\gamma$)
